items.headline: Dow Climbs as Tech Drag Weighs on Nasdaq Amid Earnings Anticipation
items.summary: U.S. equities closed mixed today, October 12, 2026, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average posting solid gains, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite edged lower. Investors navigated rising oil prices and a tech sector selloff, all while gearing up for a critical week of major bank earnings and inflation data. This report is for informational purposes only and is not financial advice.

items.headline: eBay Surges on Analyst Upgrade
items.summary: Shares of $EBAY jumped 4.12% to $132 after Morgan Stanley raised its price target and named the online marketplace a top pick among its covered companies.

items.headline: CCC Intelligent Solutions Soars on Takeover Reports
items.summary: CCC Intelligent Solutions Holdings ($CCC) surged 9.54% following reports that private equity firms are in advanced talks for a potential takeover.

items.headline: Figs Jumps on Positive Industry Review
items.summary: Healthcare apparel maker $FIGS saw its stock jump over 12% today, continuing a multi-day rally, following a positive industry review.

items.headline: Lumentum Tumbles Amid Semiconductor Selloff
items.summary: Optical products maker $LITE fell 7.42% as semiconductor and AI-infrastructure stocks faced a broad selloff, with investors showing caution on AI spending.

items.headline: SanDisk Declines Ahead of Earnings
items.summary: Flash-memory storage company $SNDK fell 6.98% today, driven by caution from investors ahead of its upcoming earnings report and renewed selling across the memory sector.

items.headline: Contineum Therapeutics Plunges
items.summary: Contineum Therapeutics ($CTNM) experienced a significant drop of 31.61% today, leading the list of top losers, though specific company-related news for the decline was not immediately verified.

items.headline: Energy and Consumer Staples Lead, Tech Sector Lagging
items.summary: Today, the Energy (+1.45%) and Consumer Staples (+1.17%) sectors were among the top performers, signaling a rotation into more value-oriented stocks. Conversely, the Technology (-1.25%) and Communication Services (-0.4%) sectors lagged significantly, reflecting investor apprehension and a broad selloff in semiconductor and AI-infrastructure shares. Utilities also showed strong performance over the last five days.

items.headline: Focus Shifts to Upcoming Inflation Data and Bank Earnings
items.summary: Markets are keenly awaiting key economic data releases this week, including the September Consumer Price Index (CPI) on Wednesday and the Producer Price Index (PPI) on Thursday. U.S. bond trading was closed today for Columbus Day. The 'Big 6' U.S. banks, including $JPM, $BAC, and $C, are set to kick off Q3 earnings season tomorrow, with aggregate earnings expected to grow 14%.

items.headline: Americans Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford Win Nobel Economics Prize
items.summary: Economists Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford were awarded the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences today for their foundational work on models that have helped governments and central banks manage economic shocks.

items.headline: Oil Prices Continue Ascent Amid Geopolitical Concerns
items.summary: Brent crude prices rose 1.8% to $106.65 per barrel today, adding to investor concerns amidst geopolitical developments and discussions around global energy supply.
